text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The question of state visits abroad frequently causes a certain amount of confusion.", "gist": "State visits abroad often cause confusion."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "in Switzerland the president is not the head of state, as is the case in other countries.", "gist": "Switzerland does not have a president as head of state, unlike other countries."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "full Federal Council", "gist": "Swiss Federal Council"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it is extremely rare for all seven members to travel abroad together", "gist": "It is very rare for all seven members of the Federal Council to travel abroad together."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "the few exceptions being the opening of the Simplon tunnel in Domodossola in 1906 and occasional stopovers during Federal Council outings – none of which were considered state visits)", "gist": "Exceptions include the Simplon tunnel opening in 1906 and some stopovers, but these were not state visits."}]}
